          t1.NuCnpjLoja,
          t1.FlAtivo,
          t1.FlPorteA,

          t1.QtGravamesMercado,
          t1.VrGravamesMercado

      WHERE t1.NuAnoMes BETWEEN 202506 AND 202509 AND t1.NuCnpjLoja IN
           (

           '53157163000149'
           );
